limitations: These distance hypotheses were designed after previous 2023 validation diagnostics; this remains an exploratory, previously exposed validation comparison.
Candidate selection uses training period-group CV only; winning CV AP is optimistic.
The reference CV is reused from the same frozen rows/groups, not refit or retuned.
Only the selected candidate is newly evaluated on validation; losing candidates are not evaluated there. Reference validation metrics are frozen source results.
Decreasing distance constraints are modeling assumptions holding other features fixed, not proof of fire propagation physics.
Pooled top10% counts repeat event/issue/horizon decisions, not independent alerts.
No calibration, response threshold, deployment or locked-2025 evaluation occurs.
